It's only checked with fill, we need to update consume engine but this PR looks good to me 👍 Devnet-6 v1.0.0 is out! https://github.com/ethereum/execution-spec-tests/releases/tag/pectra-devnet-6%40v1.0.0 cc <@341574016160497665> <@508125616940515329> <@543900561460822016> <@827653956955406406> <@429719902363058177> <@758579010027782144> <@259648573401071617> 👋 sorry to bother. I'm updating the prysm end to end testing code for electra by using your branch ``` // devnet 5 version replace github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum => github.com/s1na/go-ethereum v1.8.4-0.20241219180720-88dadb7c83c4 ``` did something change between your branch and 1.14.12 around `output, err = c.caller.CallContract(ctx, msg, opts.BlockNumber)` some of our old tests TestMerkleTrieRoot_EmptyTrie have been returning 0 on output changing 1.14.12 to your branch and saying `no contract at that address` ``` err := _DepositContract.contract.Call(opts, &out, "get_deposit_root") ``` forgive my novice understanding on the execution side 🙏 Hm I can’t think of any reason why that would happen at the top of my head. But if you send over a repro happy to look into it

excerpts.author: siladu
excerpts.content:
This is to support the nonce mismatch test in EEST v1.3.1
https://github.com/ethereum/execution-spec-tests/pull/1158

Question: without this exception mapping in place, should we expect the hive version (`consume-engine`) of this test to fail as well, or is it only checked when running `uv fill ...`?

excerpts.author: marioevz
excerpts.content: It's only checked with fill, we need to update consume engine but this PR looks good to me 👍
